purpose: Teach: うんちく/コトバ/一安心/すませ/まちがい/つづい/マイペース/大雑把

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ゲームのうんちく語りすぎだろ
lines.en: You talk way too much about game trivia, Riku.
lines.style: Light, affectionate exasperation — the tone of someone calling out a friend mid-rant. Slight eye-roll in the voice. Not mean, just tired of hearing about it. Fast clip.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、流行りのコトバ使うの好きだろ、桜
lines.en: You're the one who loves using trendy words, though, Sakura.
lines.style: Playful deflection, gently turning it back on her. Warm underneath the teasing. Unhurried — he's comfortable enough to banter. Slight smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、テスト返って一安心だろ?
lines.en: So the test came back and you can relax now, huh?
lines.style: Knowing smirk in her voice. She's reading him, checking if he's actually feeling relief or hiding something. Casual but probing. Slight rise at the end like she's testing his reaction.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、宿題すませてから遊べよ、桜
lines.en: You've gotta finish your homework before you play around, Sakura.
lines.style: Quiet older-brother energy without the arrogance. Not lecturing — just stating what he already knows she should do. Steady, matter-of-fact tone. The voice of someone who actually cares.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、答えにまちがい多すぎだろ
lines.en: You had way too many wrong answers on that test.
lines.style: Gentle rib, not a jab. She's pointing out something she noticed, the way you mention a loose thread to a friend. Teasing but not unkind. Slight drawl on 'too many.'

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、部活つづいてるな、桜
lines.en: You've been keeping up with club, haven't you?
lines.style: Genuine notice in his voice — not performative praise, just observation. Warm but restrained. The smallest note of respect for her follow-through. Steady, direct.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ホント、マイペースだよな
lines.en: You really do just go at your own pace, don't you?
lines.style: Fond exasperation mixed with acceptance. He's stated this before; she hasn't changed. Slightly slower pace, almost wistful. The voice of someone who gets her stubbornness and respects it anyway.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前のノート、大雑把過ぎだぞ、桜
lines.en: Your notebook is way too rough and sloppy, Sakura.
lines.style: Teasing that lands close — he's noticed she doesn't care much about neat notes. Not mean-spirited; almost conspiratorial. A small laugh underneath it. Quick, casual tone.
